engines.description: Search engines whose results pages the Chrome extension's search module captures and the server accepts: google, bing, duckduckgo. Searches on an engine not listed are skipped.

captureAiOverview.description: Save Google's AI Overview as snippets of the search's source.

settleMinutes.description: A search is indexed only after this long without new activity, so results you open shortly after searching land in one update of its source.

maxQueriesPerRun.description: Most searches one run of the search-queries-index cron indexes; the next run continues with the rest.

namespace.description: Namespace for search sources and graph entities.
